verdict.rationale: A government digital service like UKVI could plausibly publish developer APIs and machine-readable specs, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions an API, OpenAPI spec, or any downloadable machine-readable interface definition. The evidence covers only human-facing guidance, online application flows, an ID Check app and email alerts.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
